description: Headless CLI surface shared by walctl (Swift) and the future walctl (Kotlin/JVM). Both binaries must accept exactly these commands/flags and emit the same JSON envelopes so the same end-to-end scripts drive both platforms. In `--remote` mode the CLI forwards the command to a running debug build (DevServer) instead of executing it against the in-process core.

globalFlags.description: mock: fixtures transport; live: real backend (needs --api-url and a session); remote: forward to DevServer
Backend base URL for live mode
Machine-readable output (always on; kept for parity)
